job.title: Welder First Class
job.description:
Welder (First Class)
Location: Sunshine West, VIC, 3020
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $76,000 – $80,000 per year + superannuation


About the Role
We are partnering with DH Engineering, an engineering company based in Sunshine West specialising in precision metal manufacturing. DH Engineering are seeking a Trade qualified First Class Welder / Boiler Maker to join their specialised team. You will handle precision fabrication, material preparation, component assembly and inspection in accordance with engineering drawings, company Quality Management Systems and Australian standards.

Key Responsibilities
•Read and interpret engineering drawings and weld symbols.
•Perform precision MIG, TIG, Stick, Spot, Laser and Plastic welding.
•Calibrate welding equipment settings for different materials.
•Inspect parts using micrometres, vernier callipers, and gauges.
•Clean, grind, finish, and coat completed metal assemblies.
•Operate CNC plasma cutter, centre lathes, and milling machines.
•Maintain strict quality records and follow workplace WHS rules.
•Work effectively with team members to meet project timelines.

Skills & Experience
•Certificate III in Engineering (Fabrication or Welding Trade) or equivalent qualification.
•Minimum 1 year full time relevant welding or metal fabrication experience in an engineering or manufacturing environment.
•Proven precision welding experience working to tight tolerances using MIG, TIG, Stick, Spot, Laser & Plastic welders, manual machining tools and CNC plasma cutters.
•Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, welding symbols, technical specifications, safety documentation, work instructions, and communicate effectively in English with a high level of accuracy.
•Highly Desirable - Certificate IV in Project Management Practice.

How to Apply
Submit your resume outlining your qualifications and relevant experience. All Applications are welcomed from Australian citizens and permanent residents. Applicants must have the legal right to work in Australia.

job.title: Qualified Fitter
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced trade qualified Maintenance Fitter to join a well established manufacturing operation based in Preston. This is a genuine hands on maintenance role working across production machinery, breakdowns, preventative maintenance and machine setting. 

Benefits

• RDO built into the roster
• Free onsite parking at the Preston site
• Permanent full time position
• Long term job security with a large, established manufacturer
• Overtime opportunities 
• Stable manufacturing site with ongoing maintenance requirements, not project based work
• A site where safety is genuinely taken seriously, not just talked about.

The Role

• Set, adjust and change production machinery to suit different products and production requirements
• Maintain and repair pumps, gearboxes, bearings, shafts, motors and rotating equipment
• Diagnose and repair hydraulic and pneumatic systems and associated components
• Work closely with production operators to complete machine adjustments, changeovers and repairs while minimising downtime
• Complete mechanical breakdown repairs across production machinery and plant equipment
• Carry out scheduled preventative maintenance, inspections and servicing
• Fault find mechanical issues and identify the root cause of equipment failures

About You

• Australian recognised Fitter and Turner, Mechanical Fitter or equivalent trade qualification
• Proven experience setting, adjusting and changing over production machinery
• Demonstrated experience working as a Maintenance Fitter within manufacturing or industrial environments
• Strong breakdown maintenance and mechanical fault finding experience
• Solid preventative maintenance experience across mechanical plant and equipment
• Experience working with pumps, gearboxes, bearings, shafts, hydraulics and pneumatics
• Able and willing to work a rotating day, afternoon and night shift roster

If you are a trade qualified fitter who enjoys fault finding, machine setting and keeping production equipment running properly, we would like to hear from you.
